topic: If I had saved more, I’d be rich now
title: If I had saved more, I’d be rich now
pt: Foco da aula: condicional misto: if + past perfect, would + infinitivo (passado → presente)

solo90.name: Pausa
solo90.desc: 5 minutos: câmera e microfone desligados. O professor anota 3 erros reais ouvidos até aqui para a correção final.

lines.en: Dan, look at this spreadsheet. If I had saved more ten years ago, I would be rich now, and I would not be working late.
lines.pt: Dan, olhe esta planilha. Se eu tivesse poupado mais há dez anos, estaria rico agora e não estaria trabalhando até tarde.

lines.en: Do not be so hard on yourself, Blake. If you had not bought that apartment, you would not have your own place today.
lines.pt: Não seja tão duro consigo mesmo, Blake. Se você não tivesse comprado aquele apartamento, não teria sua própria casa hoje.

lines.en: True, but the mortgage is huge. If I had waited a little longer, the prices would be lower and the stress would be smaller.
lines.pt: Verdade, mas a hipoteca é enorme. Se eu tivesse esperado um pouco mais, os preços estariam menores e o estresse seria menor.

lines.en: My cousin told me that she regretted not investing sooner in her career.
lines.pt: Minha prima me disse que se arrependia de não ter investido antes na carreira.

lines.en: Exactly. If she had started at twenty-five, she would be earning much more now.
lines.pt: Exatamente. Se ela tivesse começado aos vinte e cinco, estaria ganhando muito mais agora.

lines.en: I think about it too. If I had not changed jobs in March, I would still be stuck in a boring team downtown.
lines.pt: Eu penso nisso também. Se eu não tivesse mudado de emprego em março, ainda estaria preso numa equipe chata no centro.

lines.en: So your decision paid off. I wish I had been that brave, because my savings account has hardly grown since then.
lines.pt: Então sua decisão valeu a pena. Queria ter sido tão corajoso, porque minha poupança quase não cresceu desde então.

lines.en: It is not too late, you know. If you set a monthly budget now, you will see a real difference by next year.
lines.pt: Não é tarde demais. Se você definir um orçamento mensal agora, verá uma diferença real até o ano que vem.

lines.en: Fair point. I would feel calmer if I had a clear plan, and my wife would stop worrying about our expenses.
lines.pt: Boa observação. Eu me sentiria mais calmo se tivesse um plano claro, e minha esposa pararia de se preocupar com nossas despesas.

lines.en: Then let us sit down after lunch. If we finish today, we can send the plan to the bank before Friday.
lines.pt: Então vamos nos sentar depois do almoço. Se terminarmos hoje, podemos enviar o plano ao banco antes de sexta.

lines.en: Deal. If you had not pushed me, I would still be staring at this spreadsheet and doing nothing about it!
lines.pt: Combinado. Se você não tivesse me empurrado, eu ainda estaria olhando para esta planilha sem fazer nada!

facts.big: If I had saved, I would be rich
facts.label: Passado muda o presente
If + had + particípio, would + infinitivo
facts.sub: Use quando a condição está no passado e o resultado está no presente: If I had saved more, I would be rich now. Em português: “se eu tivesse poupado, estaria rico”.

facts.label: if antes ou depois
facts.sub: A ordem pode mudar: I would be rich now if I had saved more. Quando o if vem primeiro, use vírgula; quando vem depois, não precisa de vírgula.

pages.title: If I had saved more · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a grey morning in Boston. Blake arrives early at the office. He opens a spreadsheet. The coffee is ready. Dan comes in. The two colleagues start talking about money.

“Dan, look at this spreadsheet. If I had saved more ten years ago, I would be rich now, and I would not be working late.” says Blake. “Do not be so hard on yourself, Blake. If you had not bought that apartment, you would not have your own place today.” says Dan. “True, but the mortgage is huge. If I had waited a little longer, the prices would be lower and the stress would be smaller.” says Blake.

lines: Blake
Dan, look at this spreadsheet. If I had saved more ten years ago, I would be rich now, and I would not be working late.

Blake

You

Blake

You
